title: Collateral Valuation Standard — Depreciation Method for the Equipment & Vehicle Loans Post-Release Test
content:
**Standard.** The value of the units of an Equipment & Vehicle Loans loan tested against the post-release margin depends on how long ago the units were pledged at funding: when more than 36 whole months have passed since funding, the pledged value still securing the loan is depreciated on a declining balance, reduced by the depreciation rate once for each full year since funding, each year's reduction acting on the value left after the year before; when 12 to 36 whole months have passed, it is depreciated on a straight line, reduced by the depreciation rate times the full years since funding, all acting on the pledged value; when fewer than 12 whole months have passed, the pledged value itself is tested. The tested value is rounded to cents.

## Terms used

- **Pledged value still securing the loan** — the pledged value of every unit pledged less that of every unit since released.
- **Full years since funding** — the whole months since funding divided by 12, any remainder dropped.
- **Depreciation rate** — the annual percentage that applies to the units for this test.

## Method by age of the loan

| Whole months since funding | Method | Tested value |
|---|---|---|
| more than 36 | declining balance | the pledged value reduced by the rate once for each full year, each reduction acting on the value left after the year before |
| 12 to 36 | straight line | the pledged value reduced by the rate multiplied by the full years, all acting on the pledged value |
| fewer than 12 | none | the pledged value itself |

## Worked figures (hypothetical: pledged value 200000.00, depreciation rate 10 percent a year)

- **40 whole months (3 full years), declining balance.** After year one 180000.00; after year two 162000.00; after year three 145800.00. Tested value 145800.00.
- **36 whole months (3 full years), straight line.** Three years at 10 percent take 30 percent off the pledged value: 140000.00.
- **30 whole months (2 full years), straight line.** 20 percent off: 160000.00.
- **11 whole months.** 200000.00, the pledged value itself.
